_meta.bundles: bundle id -> view: holders (a roster of the listed seeds: in force or a predecessor), not_held, void_fork. The ids are v6 genesis-bundle object ids; the reader takes the roster as data.
_meta.generator: gen_build_standing_v2.py over gen_row_statements_v5.py, gen_binary_manifest_v1.py and gen_genesis_bundles_v6.py (independent of verify)
_meta.keys: Key(n): ML-DSA-65 seed [n]*32, Ed25519 seed [(n+100)%256]*32. Holders A,B,C,D = 1,2,3,4; pipeline P = 5 (node); owner O = 6 (user); O2 = 7 (user); Q = 8 (node); stranger X = 9 (no record); O3 = 10 (no record). key_records are inserted into a KeyRecordDirectory for every case.
_meta.lineage: each bundle's prev; descends(head, from) follows prev from head over the bundles listed (a not_held bundle is not held; a walk that ends without reaching from is not a descendant).
_meta.owner_bindings: each case's owner_binding names the LIVE bindings of the grantee's key the reader holds (live: each the owner's statement and the key's cosign, one row id) and the other held bindings of the key (ended, or another owner's), by statement; a reader derives owner (author), key (sub) and row id from the statement, and the owner is the one owner the live bindings name (none live, or two owners: no owner). binding_signer_seeds are the owners' keys for reading them (O3's key record is not in key_records).
_meta.receipts: the walk reads no receipts: a build row whose grant has ended (or whose acceptance is withdrawn) is refused, Kernel's 'counted but not in force' (CC 2.4.1.1, What stays in force); see kernel_not_covered.
_meta.spec: FSD-008 Phase 1b; the build row, grant, acceptance, ends and row state as settled with CIRISConstitution 2026-11-22; CC 4.5.5 scope match; CC 2.7.7 rule 2; CC 2.6.1.9 counted rows; CC 3.2 and CC 3.1.2.1 for one owner's several live bindings and a key with no owner (2026-11-23).
_meta.statements: every statement is named by its SHA-256 (hex) in the pool files
_meta.verdicts: stands | refused:{token} | waiting:{token+token} (key, voice, record, row, bundle, grant, acceptance, owner_binding). withdrawal_state: unknown | none_held | withdrawn | superseded. composers null = no view.
